name: magicsunday/coding-standard
description: Shared coding standard, static-analysis, test and CI configuration for the magicsunday/* projects.

suggest.shipmonk/phpstan-rules: Required for the opt-in strict PHPStan tier (phpstan/strict.neon): ^4.0
suggest.symplify/phpstan-rules: Required for the opt-in strict PHPStan tier (phpstan/strict.neon): ^14.0
suggest.spaze/phpstan-disallowed-calls: Required for the case-folding bans in phpstan/disallowed-calls.neon, included by the strict tier: ^4.13
suggest.roave/backward-compatibility-check: Public-API break detection for a library consumer: ^8.21. Install it via its OWN tools/backward-compatibility/composer.json, never into the root manifest — it requires php ~8.4.0 || ~8.5.0 and would make the root lock uninstallable on an 8.3 matrix leg (see the README)

scripts-descriptions.ci:test:php:lint: Syntax-check every PHP file via phplint (path-driven, not a hand-kept list).
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:php:analyse: PHPStan level 6 plus the case-folding bans over the PHP files under this package's own bin/ and tests/ (its non-PHP gate scripts and the .sh harnesses are a separate concern) — previously only phplint-syntax-checked. Excludes tests/consumer, a separate fixture project analysed by the Consumer smoke steps.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:php:analyse-cases: Fixture-driven case proving phpstan.neon's own include of phpstan/disallowed-function-calls.neon actually fires — the one link the consumer-facing disallowed-calls self-test cannot cover, since it only ever runs through tests/consumer's installed copy.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:json: Validate that every shipped JSON config parses (path-driven, not a hand-kept file list).
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:json-cases: Fixture-driven cases proving the JSON lint gate reports a malformed file, a missing file (a dangling symlink) and an unreadable file, that its discovery actually recurses and prunes vendored/installed trees and VCS metadata, that a symlink cannot be followed out of the scan root, and that a consumer-controlled file or directory name cannot forge a workflow command in the report.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:version: Assert package.json's version matches every npm tag pin documented in the README, so the install instructions never point at a tag predating the fix they describe.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:version-lockstep: Fixture-driven cases proving the version lockstep gate reports a stale README pin, a missing pin and an unreadable file — run against this repository alone it only ever takes the happy path.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:gitattributes: Assert this repository's own .gitattributes export-ignores every templates/gitattributes entry that names a path this repository actually has, so a future template addition cannot silently leave this package's own dist archive out of step.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:gitattributes-lockstep: Fixture-driven cases proving the gitattributes lockstep gate accepts a repository that is not applicable to a given template entry and rejects every drift class — run against this repository alone it only ever takes the happy path.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:release-tag: Assert the tag package.json's version names actually resolves on the remote and, if it does, that it is an ancestor of HEAD — i.e. that this branch's own history actually contains it — the two failure shapes ci:test:version cannot see, since it only ever compares two copies inside this repository. Runs on push to main (see .github/workflows/ci.yml) and on every tag push (see .github/workflows/release-tag-lockstep.yml), never on the release PR; no matching tag yet is not a violation.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:release-tag-lockstep: Fixture-driven cases proving the release tag gate accepts an unresolved tag, accepts a resolved tag that is HEAD or an ancestor of it, rejects a resolved tag whose commit is outside this branch's history, and reports a transport failure, a malformed version, an unborn HEAD, and a resolve-but-cannot-fetch/cannot-resolve-to-a-commit remote state each as a setup failure rather than silently — against disposable local git repositories, never the real network.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:templates: Fixture-driven cases proving the template lockstep gate accepts the canon and rejects every drift class.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:disallowed-calls: Fixture-driven cases proving the case-folding config loads from an installed vendor layout and reports all five banned functions, both on its own and through the strict tier. Requires tests/consumer to be installed.
scripts-descriptions.ci:test:phpunit: Runs this repository's own PHPUnit suite (tests/Support and GateTestCase's meta-tests) — not the fixture-driven bash suites, which have their own ci:test:* scripts.
